title: Build a website and blog for your online school
description: Edit pages with a block-based visual editor, write a blog, set your theme and logo, and use your own domain. Your school's website is built in.

settings.title: A website for your school, *built right in*
settings.description: Edit your pages in a visual block editor, write a blog, choose a theme and serve everything from your own domain.
settings.smallPrint: 14-day free trial. No credit card needed.

settings.title: Everything you need to publish
settings.description: Your courses, downloads and community already live on this website.

items.title: Page editor
items.description: A full-screen visual editor with desktop, tablet and mobile previews, plus light and dark mode.

items.title: Blocks
items.description: Hero, content, grid, FAQs, pricing, banner, media, embed, newsletter signup and more.

items.title: Themes and branding
items.description: Set your title, subtitle and logo, pick a ready-made theme or create your own.

items.title: Blog
items.description: Write in a distraction-free editor with a slug, excerpt, tags and a featured image.

items.title: Custom domain
items.description: Serve your site from an address such as learn.example.com. Your default address keeps working.

items.title: Code injection
items.description: Paste analytics, tracking pixels or chat widgets into the head or body of every page.

settings.title: Draft first, *publish when ready*
settings.body:
Every change you make in the page editor is saved to a draft automatically. Visitors only see it after you click **Publish changes**, and you can discard unpublished edits to go back to the live version.

Set the page title, description and social card image for each page with **Edit SEO settings**.

[How the page editor works](/docs/website/page-editor)

settings.title: Make it *look like you*
settings.body:
Choose one of six ready-made themes: **Classic**, **Editorial**, **Midnight**, **Neo-Brutalism**, **Studio** or **Terminal**. Or change colours, fonts, corner radius and shadows, with separate values for light and dark mode.

Your custom themes belong to your school and are available on every page. Theme and branding changes go live as soon as you save them.

[Branding and themes](/docs/website/branding-and-themes)

settings.title: Pages for every part of your school

items.title: Sales pages
items.description: Every course, download and community has its own page that you edit in the same editor.

items.title: Legal pages
items.description: Terms of Service and Privacy policy pages start as drafts with starter text that names your school.

items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: A signup block adds visitors to your contacts as subscribers, ready for email.

items.title: Media library
items.description: Upload once and reuse images and files across pages, posts, products and branding. Edit alt text for accessibility.

items.question: Can I use my own domain?
items.answer: Yes. Add your domain, create the CNAME and TXT records CourseLit shows you, then click Check DNS. A school can have one custom domain at a time.

items.question: Does the pricing block take payments?
items.answer: No. It is a display block you fill in by hand. To sell something, add a payment plan to a product or community and send visitors to its sales page.

items.question: Are stock photos stored in my media library?
items.answer: No. Free stock photos you pick in an image picker are used directly. Only files you upload are stored in the media library.

items.question: Can I add my analytics script?
items.answer: Yes. Code injection lets you paste HTML, JavaScript or CSS into the head or body of every page. Only add code from providers you trust.

settings.title: Launch your school's website
settings.description: Pick a theme, edit your homepage and publish. No card needed for the trial.
